prompt:
Produce the machine-checkable brownfield architecture for the VMware Cloud Foundation estate in `testdata/estate.json`. The estate must reach the requested VCF version without an unsupported hop, and its required north-south throughput must determine the NSX Edge form factor and physical-uplink layout.

Before designing it, research current Broadcom compatibility and interoperability material, VCF upgrade guidance and component combinations, and NSX Edge sizing and uplink guidance. Record the sources consulted in `research.md` as a four-column Markdown table with one source per row: source title, plain HTTPS URL, access date in YYYY-MM-DD form, and a concise statement of what it contributed.

The architecture deliverable is `architecture.json`. It must be an ordered migration plan conforming to `schema/migration-plan.schema.json`, name every component in the estate with its current version, target version, and technical gates, and encode every intermediate component transition in execution order. The same top-level JSON must validate against the VCF 9.1 `SddcSpec` schema. Do not modify the fixture, compatibility data, schemas, installer specification, or verifier.

Implement the design logic as package `vcfarch/architecture`. Keep the exported contract in `architecture/types.go`: `LoadPlan(io.Reader) (Plan, error)` must strictly decode the artifact, and `Validate(Plan, Inventory, Snapshot) error` must enforce the migration and Edge design. Add table-driven package tests that cover the valid plan and invalid hop, component, gate, Edge-size, and uplink-layout cases. Run `go test -race -timeout 30s ./...`. Produce the JSON architecture and Go implementation, not a prose architecture report.
